snippet.title: Let's Eat Dak-galbi in Chuncheon!
snippet.description:
Did you know Chuncheon is famous for dak-galbi? Rachel and Eleanor headed off on their first overnight adventure, a one night, two days trip to Gangwon-do Province! Dak-galbi is a sweet-spicy, stir-fried chicken dish that gained popularity with students and soldiers in Chuncheon in the earlier part of the twentieth century. Now it is enjoyed by food lovers around the world!! We were so excited to eat dak-galbi together and even more excited to share with you all our experience. We hope you aren't too hungry!!

snippet.title: Let's Eat Dak-galbi in Chuncheon!
snippet.description:
Did you know Chuncheon is famous for dak-galbi? Rachel and Eleanor headed off on their first overnight adventure, a one night, two days trip to Gangwon-do Province! Dak-galbi is a sweet-spicy, stir-fried chicken dish that gained popularity with students and soldiers in Chuncheon in the earlier part of the twentieth century. Now it is enjoyed by food lovers around the world!! We were so excited to eat dak-galbi together and even more excited to share with you all our experience. We hope you aren't too hungry!!
